apps.name: Pages
apps.replaces: the Word you don't pay for
apps.line: Letters, essays, reports, a whole novel. Real pages, real styles, and a .docx that opens anywhere.
caps: Real pages, not an endless scroll
Page layout with headers, footers, page numbers, columns and footnotes, so what you see is what prints.
Styles that do the work
Paragraph and character styles, an outline sidebar and an automatic table of contents.
Tables, images and shapes
Drop them in, drag them where you want, wrap text around them.
Word files in, Word files out
Open and save .docx, export PDF, print. Nobody has to know what you wrote it in.

apps.name: Numbers
apps.replaces: the Excel you don't pay for
apps.line: Spreadsheets with a real formula engine, charts that look like someone cared, and .xlsx that round-trips.
caps: A real formula engine
SUM, IF, lookups, dates, text and the rest of the everyday functions, recalculating as you type.
Many sheets, one file
Tabs for sheets, frozen rows and columns, sorting and filtering.
Charts you would put on a wall
Bar, line, pie and scatter, live-linked to the cells they draw from.
Excel and CSV, both ways
Open and save .xlsx, import and export .csv, export PDF.

apps.name: Keynote
apps.replaces: the PowerPoint you don't pay for
apps.line: Slides that look designed, a presenter view that helps, and .pptx files your boss can open.
caps: Slide navigator and layouts
Reorder by dragging, pick a layout, keep a consistent look across the deck.
Transitions and builds
Smooth slide transitions and object animations that run at your display's refresh rate.
Presenter view
Current slide, next slide, your notes and a timer on your screen while the audience sees the deck.
PowerPoint in, PowerPoint out
Open and save .pptx, export PDF for handouts.

apps.name: Preview
apps.replaces: the Acrobat you don't pay for
apps.line: Read, mark up, sign and reshuffle PDFs and images. No account, no "upgrade to edit".
caps: PDFs that open instantly
Thumbnails, continuous scroll, search inside the document, zoom that stays sharp.
Mark up and sign
Highlight, underline, draw, add text and place your signature.
Rearrange pages
Reorder, rotate and delete pages, and merge several PDFs into one.
Images too
View, rotate, crop and convert PNG, JPEG and WebP.

apps.name: Text
apps.line: A plain text editor that opens a huge file before you finish blinking.
caps: Opens big files without choking
Log files and exports that make other editors freeze are fine here.
Plain or rich, your choice
Switch a document between plain text and simple rich text.
Find and replace with regular expressions
Across the document, with a live count of matches.
Any encoding
UTF-8 by default, and it can read the older encodings your files still use.

apps.name: Notes
apps.replaces: the OneNote you don't pay for
apps.line: Quick notes that stay on your computer, with folders, checklists and search that actually finds things.
caps: Folders and pins
Keep notes in folders, pin the ones you open all day.
Checklists, tables and images
Rich notes without a rich-note learning curve.
Search across everything
Type and the list narrows as you go.
Yours, on your disk
Notes are stored locally. Export to Markdown or HTML any time.

apps.name: Freeform
apps.replaces: the whiteboard you don't pay for
apps.line: An endless canvas for sketches, plans and messy thinking.
caps: An infinite canvas
Pan and zoom smoothly; there is no edge to run into.
Shapes with connectors that stick
Move a box and the arrows follow.
Sticky notes and freehand
Pen, highlighter, text and notes on the same board.
Pictures and export
Drop in images, export the board as PNG, SVG or PDF.

apps.name: Calendar
apps.replaces: the Outlook calendar you don't pay for
apps.line: Day, week, month and year, with recurring events and no account to sign into.
caps: Every view you expect
Day, week, month and year, with drag to create and drag to move.
Several calendars, one screen
Colour-code home, work and school and toggle them on and off.
Repeating events done properly
Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, with exceptions.
Standard .ics
Import and export so your events are never locked in.

apps.name: Reminders
apps.replaces: the To Do you don't pay for
apps.line: Lists, due dates and nudges. The smallest possible amount of software for getting things done.
caps: Lists and smart lists
Today, Scheduled and Flagged build themselves from your reminders.
Due dates, times and repeats
Daily, weekly, monthly, whatever your life needs.
Subtasks
Break a big thing into small things and tick them off.
Offline and private
Nothing is synced anywhere. It is a file on your computer.

apps.name: Contacts
apps.replaces: the address book you don't pay for
apps.line: People, with all the fields you need and none of the cloud you don't.
caps: Proper contact cards
Several phones, emails and addresses, birthdays, notes and a photo.
Groups and fast search
Sort people into groups; type a few letters to find anyone.
vCard and CSV
Import from your phone or your old mail app, export whenever you like.
Duplicates, merged
Find the same person twice and combine the cards.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.replaces: the Calculator you already had, but better
apps.line: Basic, scientific and programmer modes, with a tape you can scroll back through.
caps: Three modes
Basic for the till, scientific for the exam, programmer for hex, binary and bit work.
A tape of everything you did
Scroll back, click a result and reuse it.
Keyboard first
Type the whole sum and press Enter; no mouse needed.
Copy exactly
Results copy at full precision, not what fits on the display.
